name: Amanda Lasairfhiona
source:
Defiant to the norm with sarcasm to spare, Lorraine was quite the influence on Marianne in their youth. Her best friend at St. Samthann School for Young Ladies in Ireland, the two were thick as thieves. With a friendship like theirs, you'd think Marianne would talk about her. Yet she doesn't.

[From [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/paid-see-submission-guidelines-the-letter-a-horror-visual-novel]Castingall.club[/url]]
